title: We Know Thee Who Thou Art
description: We Know Thee Who Thou Art in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by William Bright, first published in 1865. The tune, SELLINGE, is by John Pyke Hullah (1868). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: We know Thee who Thou art, Lord Je-sus, Ma-ry's Son; We know the yearn-ings of Thy heart To end Thy work be-gun.

lines: We know Thee who Thou art,
We know the yearnings of Thy heart
Has joy whene'er we seek Thy face,
We pray Thee, shield us from the curse
We dare not ask to live
But oh! when next they tempt us, give
More strength to cling to Thee.
We know Thee who Thou art,
Be Thou by will, and mind, and heart,
